hcontainer.name: schedule
hcontainer.heading: When decisions are made and finally determined

content.p: Insert:
finally determined: for when an application under this Act is finally determined, see subsections (9) and (9A).
Omit “finally determined”, substitute “ finally determined”.
Insert:

(9A) Without limiting subsection (9), if a review of a decision that has been made in respect of an application under this Act is instituted under Part 5 or 7 as prescribed, the application is finally determined when a decision on the review in respect of the application is taken to have been made as provided by any of the following provisions:
subsection 368(2) (Migration Review Tribunal written decisions);
subsection 368D(1) (Migration Review Tribunal oral decisions);
subsection 430(2) (Refugee Review Tribunal written decisions);
subsection 430D(1) (Refugee Review Tribunal oral decisions).
However, subsection (9A) does not apply in relation to the following decisions:
a decision of the Migration Review Tribunal under paragraph 349(2)(c);
a decision of the Refugee Review Tribunal under paragraph 415(2)(c).
Note: These decisions are for the remission of some matters by the relevant Tribunal.
Repeal the section, substitute:

section.heading: Grant and refusal of visa—how and when

content.p: The following decisions are taken to be made by the Minister causing a record to be made of the decision:
a decision to grant a visa;
a decision to refuse to grant a visa.
The record must state the day and time of its making.
The decision is taken to have been made on the day and at the time the record is made.
The Minister has no power to vary or revoke the decision after the day and time the record is made.
Failure to comply with subsection (2) does not affect the validity of the decision or the operation of subsection (4).

Repeal the section, substitute:

section.heading: Cancellation and revocation of cancellation of visas—how and when

content.p: The following decisions are taken to be made by the Minister causing a record to be made of the decision:
a decision to cancel a visa, or not to cancel a visa;
a decision to revoke the cancellation of a visa, or not to revoke the cancellation of a visa.
The record must state the day and time of its making.
The decision is taken to have been made on the day and at the time the record is made.
The Minister has no power to vary or revoke the decision after the day and time the record is made.
Failure to comply with subsection (2) does not affect the validity of the decision or the operation of subsection (4).

hcontainer.name: schedule
hcontainer.heading: Bar on further applications for protection visas

content.p: Repeal the heading, substitute:

section.heading: No further applications for protection visa after refusal or cancellation

content.p: Insert:
Subsections (1) and (1B) apply in relation to a non-citizen regardless of any of the following:
the grounds on which an application would be made or the criteria which the non-citizen would claim to satisfy;
whether the grounds on which an application would be made or the criteria which the non-citizen would claim to satisfy existed earlier;
the grounds on which an earlier application was made or the criteria which the non-citizen earlier claimed to satisfy;
the grounds on which a cancelled protection visa was granted or the criteria the non-citizen satisfied for the grant of that visa.
